overview: The Medford City Council approved a home rule petition for a charter commission, adopted zoning regulations for adult-use marijuana, and established zoning definitions for breweries. The council also considered sign variances, utility grants of location, a proposed historic district, and multiple municipal resolutions.

items.title: Common Victualler's License for American Legion Post 45
items.summary: The council approved a common victualler's license for American Legion Post 45 to allow food service under state COVID-19 guidelines.

items.title: Sign Denial Appeals for RIVS Juice Bar and Prestige Car Wash
items.summary: The council approved sign denial appeals for RIVS Juice Bar and Prestige Car Wash with operating and display restrictions.

items.title: Sign Denial Appeal for Fairfield Marriott
items.summary: The council approved merged petitions reversing sign denials for the Fairfield Marriott at 85 Station Landing with dimming and review conditions.

items.title: Grant of Location for Boston Gas Company / National Grid
items.summary: The council approved a grant of location to install a plastic gas main extension serving 87 Medford Street under engineering division conditions.

items.title: Grant of Location for Comcast Cable Communications
items.summary: The council approved a grant of location for underground Comcast conduit and cable installations along High Street and surrounding roads.

items.title: Proposed Historic District at 16 Foster Court
items.summary: The council tabled a proposed single-parcel historic district at 16 Foster Court to allow the developer and historic commission time to finalize architectural compromises.

items.title: Home Rule Petition for a Charter Commission
items.summary: The council approved transmitting a home rule petition to the General Court authorizing an election for a nine-member Charter Commission.

items.title: Zoning Ordinance Amendment for Breweries and Brew Pubs
items.summary: The council adopted zoning ordinance amendments establishing definitions and use regulations for breweries and brew pubs.

items.title: Marijuana Zoning and Cannabis Advisory Committee Ordinances
items.summary: The council passed the adult-use Marijuana Zoning Ordinance on third reading and tabled the Cannabis Advisory Committee ordinance for legal drafting of a local tax option.

items.title: Resolutions on Ordinance Committee, SeeClickFix, and Street Permits
items.summary: The council passed resolutions establishing fall ordinance subcommittee meeting dates and requesting monthly administration reports on SeeClickFix and street opening permits.

items.title: Resolutions on Financial Audits and Excise Tax
items.summary: The council approved resolutions requesting three years of audit reports for the Treasurer-Collector's office, hiring updates for a permanent treasurer, and a report on auto excise billing.

items.title: Commendation and Condolence Resolutions
items.summary: The council passed resolutions congratulating Razzo's Grill on its 15th anniversary and expressing condolences on the passings of Teresa Galoni and Catherine Gorman Rodriguez.

items.title: Resolutions on Donation Bins, Truancy, and Election Staffing
items.summary: The council referred donation bin regulations to committee, requested school department data on truancy and private school transfers, and urged hiring an election coordinator.

items.title: Resolutions on State Transportation, Halfway Houses, and Census
items.summary: The council approved sending a letter to Transportation Secretary Pollack regarding the South and Main Street intersection, scheduled a meeting on halfway houses, and requested a census update.

items.title: Resolutions on River's Edge Drive, Finances, and Recovery Meetings
items.summary: The council requested updates on River's Edge Drive paving and Q1 municipal finances, and urged support for outdoor addiction recovery meetings during the pandemic.

items.title: Common Victualler's License for 7-Eleven
items.summary: The council approved a common victualler's license for 7-Eleven at 133 Main Street.
